item.title: All missions in the Modern Warfare 4 campaign
item.description: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 campaign mission list is, as always for a Call of Duty game, fairly brief in the grand scheme of video games. These campaigns are the equivalent of a high-octane blockbuster movie, where it delivers one memorable moment after another, whether you're fighting it out on the beach of a fictional South Korean city, chasing a van through the streets of Paris, or escaping from a North Korean prison.

item.title: Marvel Officially Renames X-Men’s Most Complicated Character After 50 Years
item.description: Betsy Braddock has had one of the most convoluted histories of any X-Men character since her debut in the pages of Captain Britain nearly 50 years ago, and when it comes to Marvel Comics lore that is really saying something. Best known as Psylocke , one of two characters who use the name, Betsy has spent her days being shuffled around the Marvel universe and trading names and bodies with one other important person.

item.title: How long is the Modern Warfare 4 campaign?
item.description: Call of Duty never has the longest campaigns in the world, but even so, you may be wondering how long Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is , because there is often some disparity from one game to the next. While the story here is a continuation of the Modern Warfare arc, following Captain Price as he's now on the run after assassinating General Shepherd, you also play as Sierra-1, a squad embroiled in a Korean war.

item.title: 'Following Orders' lockbox code location in Modern Warfare 4
item.description: The Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 lockbox code in "Following Orders" is necessary if you want to open the locked container in the small side bedroom in the house of the first family you must interrogate. This mission doesn't hold back, as you're playing as a North Korean soldier searching for a defector, and as a result, you must threaten innocent civilians. This lockbox is the only locked container to find in the mission, however, and if you obtain what is within, it makes getting the information out of the husband much easier.

item.title: Ridley Scott's 2026 Post-Apocalyptic Thriller Officially Sets Home Video Release
item.description: After a disappointing theatrical run, Ridley Scott's latest movie The Dog Stars is headed to streaming. For those who haven’t heard of The Dog Stars — which is probably a lot of people, given how poorly the film did at the box office — it's a post-apocalyptic thriller based on Peter Heller’s book of the same name.

item.title: 'GTA 6' at Risk as PS5 Hackers Officially Claim Major New Breakthrough
item.description: 2026 has been a year of tremendous progress for the PlayStation 5 jailbreaking scene, which can now free consoles from the PS5 ecosystem without a convoluted workaround . As footage of unofficial ports and pirated games proliferates, onlookers primarily have one question: What does the PS5 jailbreak situation mean for Grand Theft Auto 6 ? At first, the answer was nothing — but now, that's starting to change.

item.title: Exclusive: 2 Critical Role Heroes Team Up in The Mighty Nein’s Groundbreaking New Sequel
item.description: It’s a great time to be a fan of Critical Role ’s most deliciously diabolical adventuring party, The Mighty Nein . Since the animated series debuted in December 2025, plenty of spin-off material has expanded on Campaign 2’s colorful cast, including novels like Critical Role: The Mighty Nein - Stories Untold and live-show one-shots like Projekt Funball .

item.title: This Year’s Most Underrated Fantasy Film Officially Lands on Digital Early
item.description: A bevy of must-watch movies came out in September, like Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother , Resident Evil , and Primetime . The animated fantasy film Forgotten Island mostly slipped through the cracks, failing to make much of a splash at the box office despite a wave of positive critical and audience reviews. (It currently has a 94% on Rotten Tomatoes .)

item.title: Disney Finally Has a Plan To Save Star Wars, but There’s a Catch
item.description: As Star Wars turns 50 in 2027, the galaxy-spanning franchise’s reputation feels like it’s been on a seesaw. It has scored a handful of wins, particularly with Andor’s Emmy success and the positive reception of Disney’s latest animated offering, Maul: Shadow Lord. But for all the highs Star Wars has delivered, its lows have been so pronounced that it’s hard to imagine expectations sinking any lower.
